docs.text:
AI & Data Science Researcher with over 5 years of teaching experience in Computer Science. I specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, NLP, and Geospatial AI, with a focus on creating sustainable, data-driven applications.

I developed an AI-powered RAG-based chatbot that provides region-specific organic farming guidance using GPT-4, LangChain, FAISS, and GeoPandas, achieving a 4.6/5 expert evaluation by the Pakistan Organic Association.

I’m passionate about combining AI, data analytics, and sustainability to address real-world challenges — especially in smart and sustainable agriculture.

AI-Powered Chatbot for Organic Farming Guidance in Pakistan.
docs.text:
• Description

This project presents an AI-powered chatbot built using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to assist Pakistani farmers in transitioning to organic farming. The system integrates OpenAI GPT-4, LangChain, FAISS, and GeoPandas to deliver region-specific and real-time guidance based on local soil, crop, and climate data. By combining geospatial intelligence with generative AI, the chatbot provides accurate, contextual, and actionable advice for land preparation and organic certification. Deployed via Streamlit Cloud, it features an interactive interface that detects a farmer’s agro-ecological zone using GPS and generates customized responses to support sustainable agriculture. The system was evaluated by the Pakistan Organic Association, achieving an average expert rating of 4.6/5 for accuracy, relevance, and usability.
